notes:
- Fixed: the worn panty could clip into the buttocks on outfits whose panty renderer carries a non-uniform transform scale (the bake now reconstructs from the actual skinning)
- Fixed: a panty dropped on the floor could turn invisible to other players once you walked away (its culling bounds now follow the dropped panty)
- Changed: the grab markers (Show Grab) stay out of VRChat camera shots and screenshots (toggle on the GrabHint material)
- Improved: faster baking on high-polygon panties and dense bodies
